row.notes: Pit lane: puts car idx (< 27) in its pit box from any pit status, the way the red flag does it for every car (Sess_RedFlagSimulate_Enter, the one direct call 0x142dfb4de, idx = vehicle component +0xe8, self = [[state+0xdc0]+0x100], the same PitLaneSystem Game_Pitlane_SetVehicleStatus takes). Body: slot from the car's pit-stop record ([self+0x48]+0x938+idx*16: record+0xe0 >> 1, 12 for state 99, 0 without a record, 13 for idx > 26); Game_PitLane_VehicleEntering 0x1434cf7c0 (acts only while the status is 1 OnTrack); per-slot state self+0x210+slot*4 = 1 (slot states 0/1/2); Game_Pitlane_SetVehicleStatus(self, idx, 4 InPitBox); 0x1434d0b90 (thunk into .data1 0x150452e70; for a status other than 1 and 16 it reaches the controller switch through 0x1434cf650, .data1 0x150450f50, skipped while feature flag bit 34 is set, and hands the car to the AI with the pit-lane controller flag); re-issues an active pit-stop record (+0xd4 != 6, +0xe0 < 24) through 0x1434c03c0; logs PITLANE vehicleEnteredPitBox. Only when byte self+0x300 is set does it post MessageTriggerGarageCrewEvent request 7 PushIntoGarage (tail jump 0x1434bf1d0 to vehicleEnteredPitBox); otherwise the car stays in status 4 InPitBox. The pit lane constructor 0x1434c72f0 zeroes self+0x300 at 0x1434c7509 and no other pit lane code writes it; vehicleEnteredPitBox reads it at 0x1503eaea4 to gate the garage push. Returns nothing. Renamed from Game_PitLane_PutVehicleInGarage after verify V2152 (partial). Raised by qualilaps for the F1 1990 qualifying lap limit (owner bypass approved by the lead). | re-bindings 2026-11-18: Steam 1.0.145 (sigport --witness): 0x1434d37f0, 66/66 equal, with the pit-stop record path +0x48, +0x938 and +0xe0 at the same instructions.

The body leaves the car InPitBox (status 4) and ends with a tail jmp 0x1434bf1d0 into .data1 0x1503eae40 (PitLaneSystem::vehicleEnteredPitBox, the same call the normal pit box arrival makes after status 4 at 0x1434ba5d5/0x1434bab2c). With self+0x300 clear the car stays in the pit box, so InGarage holds only on the self+0x300 path; PutVehicleInPitBox fits the code. (2) 0x1434d0b90 (into .data1 0x150452e70) does not call the controller setter itself for a status other than 1/16. It tail-jumps to 0x1434cf650(self, idx, 1) (into .data1 0x150450f50), which calls Game_Set_VehicleController_Thunk([self+0x2b0], idx, 1, 0) only when the car has a controller entry with +0x20 set and feature flag bit 34 is clear, then may set bit idx in [[self+0x2b8]+0x90].
